name: Ontario
monthlyNote: Basic needs $825 plus a shelter allowance of up to $611, from July 1, 2026.
children: ODSP adds amounts for dependants. Ask Ontario for your household.
extra: A Work-Related Benefit of up to $100 for each family member is added in months you earn. Talli does not count it.
paid: Monthly, near the end of the month for the month ahead.
confidence: official: earnings and reporting from ontario.ca, checked 2026-10-20; amounts from news and benefit guides

report.text: Report each month's net earnings by the 7th of the next month through MyBenefits, the phone line or the income report form. Report $0 if you earned nothing.
